title: Report the actual clipboard outcome in the getting-started guide
prompt:
Fix premature copy confirmation on /getting-started. Evidence: src/app/getting-started/page.tsx:30-35 calls navigator.clipboard.writeText without awaiting it and immediately sets copied=true; line 52 then displays Copied!. A local component execution with a clipboard promise that never resolved still switched to Copied!. Rejected clipboard access likewise produces a misleading confirmation and an unhandled promise rejection. Open PR #44 fixes a separate installation page; its changed-file list does not include this guide or its local CopyBlock.

Change only src/app/getting-started/page.tsx in production. Await clipboard completion before showing success. Catch rejection and unavailable clipboard access, display a short readable failure message that suggests manually selecting the snippet, and allow retry. Keep the snippet text selectable. Preserve the existing two-second success reset and language-tab behavior, without extracting shared production helpers or changing other pages.

Add exactly one new test file, tests/getting-started-copy-result.test.ts. Use node:test with in-memory TypeScript transpilation and React/JSX, clipboard, and timer stubs to exercise the actual local CopyBlock through a test-only exposure. Verify pending writes never show success, fulfillment shows confirmation, rejection and missing clipboard show failure without escaping exceptions, and a later retry succeeds. Assert the copied text matches the selected snippet. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/getting-started-copy-result.test.ts. Use existing dependencies only. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflows, package.json, or auth changes. Do not commit or push; work on the assigned branch you are on.
